page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top centre; title block centred; body text below with a large woodcut initial Q at left. No margin notes. Digitiser banner at bottom is excluded.

main_text.head: NOBILITATE generis, pietate, prudentiâ, experientiâq; præcellentissimo Viro: Dn. JOHANNI-ANDREAE PAYERO: Patritio Scaphusiano:
main_text.p: QUOTIENS cumq; sæculi huius, in quo vivimus, indolem intueor, Nobilissime Payere, subire protinus solet Caligula Imperatoris, cateroquin parum laudati Principis, institutum nō omninō ineptum, quo ætatis suæ luxuriantem scribendi pruriginem compescere sopiréve voluit,

page.notes: The initial Q is a decorative woodcut initial joined to "VOTIENS" in small capitals; the heading lines are set in mixed roman and italic type. The running head is "PRÆFATIO." The text is transcribed as printed; the last line of the paragraph reads "luit," with the word split across lines as "vo-/luit,". Given the transcription is continued on the next page, no catchword is visible.
